title: Man Holding Cosmic Orbs
description: A mysterious man in a black coat and fedora stands at the center of a glowing oval frame, holding two detailed cosmic orbs in his hands. One orb contains a starry red planet, the other a lone figure walking through a purple field under a starry sky, while the surrounding background features surreal line art of celestial bodies, geometric shapes, floating alien-like faces, and a pathway with a smaller distant figure below.
prompt: Surreal black and white illustration with selective purple coloring, a mysterious man in a dark trench coat and fedora stands inside a glowing oval portal, holding two spherical orbs, one showing a red planet in space and the other a lone figure walking a path in a purple field, surrounded by intricate line art of planets, geometric shapes, floating stylized faces and alien creatures, with a stone path leading through a lavender field below where a smaller silhouette of the man walks, detailed ink drawing with cosmic and dreamlike atmosphere
